meta.currencyNote: All amounts are Bangladeshi taka (Tk) unless stated. US-dollar figures from booking sites are shown as published; any conversion in the audit uses an assumed Tk 122 per US dollar, which must be checked.

confidenceKey.H: Official or primary source, or two independent reports agree, dated within about a year
confidenceKey.M: One reputable report, or a business's own published price, or older than a year
confidenceKey.L: Aggregator snapshot, blog, undated page or conflicting reports: use only as a rough guide

meta.warning: Prices change. Treat every figure as a dated estimate, never a quote.

entries.subject: Intercity non-AC bus fare per km (BRTA)
entries.source: Daily Star / New Age reports of the BRTA fare chart
entries.note: Chart published after the April 2026 fuel price change.

entries.subject: Intercity non-AC bus fare per km after the September 2026 increase
entries.source: Prothom Alo: bus fares raised 17 paisa per km (BRTA had proposed 20 paisa)
entries.note: 2.23 + 0.17 = 2.40. Confirm the final gazetted rate on the BRTA site.

entries.subject: AC and premium coach fares are not set by the BRTA chart
entries.source: The Financial Express; a travel blog (tripjive)
entries.note: Operators set these fares and they rise in peak season. The range combines two undated sources.

entries.subject: Dhaka to Cox's Bazar
entries.source: BRTA chart (bus); Bangladesh Railway fares after the 20 Dec 2025 bridge charge (train); FirstTrip listing (air)
entries.note: Air fares are dynamic: 4,400 is a 'from' price, not typical. Train fares were checked against Jagonews and Prothom Alo.

entries.subject: Dhaka to Chattogram
entries.source: BRTA chart reports; Prothom Alo train fares
entries.note: Two newspapers label the 552 and 704 figures differently (seat count). 552 is the lower fare for the larger bus.

entries.subject: Dhaka to Sylhet
entries.source: Prothom Alo: train fares after the 20 Dec 2025 bridge charge
entries.note: Only the mail-train fare is unambiguous in the report. Other classes were listed in a way that could not be matched to routes, so they are left out.

entries.subject: Grilled lobster per 100 g, Cox's Bazar
entries.source: Salt Bistro and Sampan menus (the businesses' own pages)
entries.note: Salt Bistro prices exclude VAT and service charge. Lobster is sold by weight, so ask for the weight and total before ordering.

entries.subject: Seafood platter for sharing, Cox's Bazar

entries.subject: Street snacks and fried seafood, Cox's Bazar beach stalls
entries.source: Travel food guides (Hungry Bangla, Tripbase)
entries.note: Guides disagree on larger items such as stall crab or lobster, so only snacks are given.

entries.subject: Kacchi biryani plate at popular Dhaka restaurants
entries.source: Travel guide (Hello Travel)
entries.note: Older newspaper reviews list far lower prices, so published prices age quickly. Verify on the day.

entries.subject: Simple local meal at a small eatery
entries.source: Travel guide (Hello Travel)
entries.note: Rice, dal, a curry. Not specific to one town.

entries.subject: Fine dining per person in a city
entries.source: Travel guide (Hello Travel)
entries.note: Upper bound is open-ended.

entries.subject: Cox's Bazar hotel room per night, snapshot from booking sites

value.seasonality: Lowest in June (down 40-57 percent); highest Nov-Feb and on weekends and holidays

entries.source: Momondo, Kayak, Trip.com listings and a resort roundup
entries.note: Aggregator averages mix room types and dates. One traveller review says the hotel's walk-in price was about half the online price. Treat as a range, not a quote.

entries.subject: Sundarbans 3-day, 2-night tour per person (permit, stay, meals, guide included)
entries.source: Prothom Alo; Bangladesh Forest Department tourism portal
entries.note: The Forest Department portal is the official booking route. The park reopens to tourists on 1 September after the monsoon closure.

entries.subject: Saint Martin's Island visitor rules, 2025-26 season

value.needs: Online ticket and travel pass; ships leave from the Cox's Bazar river jetty

entries.source: Prothom Alo, TBS, Daily Star and bdnews24 reports
entries.note: ORBIT previously listed March as a good month. The 2026-27 rules had not been confirmed in the sources found. Check before booking.

entries.subject: Hill districts: tourism has been restricted at short notice

value.pattern: Temporary bans during heavy rain and landslides, and area restrictions in some upazilas for security reasons

entries.source: Prothom Alo, The Financial Express, bdnews24, UNB and Observer reports
entries.note: Individual reports differ in date and place. Confirm with the district administration or your operator before travelling.

entries.subject: National emergency number 999 (police, fire, ambulance)
entries.source: UNB and Dhaka Tribune reports of the Police Headquarters announcement
entries.note: Reports of 999 rescuing stranded tourists exist for Kaptai Lake and Sitakunda.

entries.subject: Bangladesh Tourist Police 24/7 helpline
entries.asOf: launched 25 September (year not shown in the report)
entries.source: Bangladesh Monitor
entries.note: Check the numbers on the Police website before printing them in the app.
